audioOutput.title: Playback device
audioOutput.disconnected: Selected output unavailable; refresh or choose another device.
audioOutput.macHelp: Changes the Mac output device for all apps. Refresh after connecting headphones or an audio interface.
audioOutput.systemHelp: This browser uses the system output device. Select it in your system sound settings.
audioOutput.browserHelp: Routes CrispAudio playback to this output. If devices are missing, use Choose output when available.
audioOutput.sent: Test signal sent. You should hear a short tone.
audioOutput.closed: Audio output closed. Reopen the app.
audioOutput.notRunning: Audio output could not start. Retry Test output.
audioOutput.busy: Output selection is already in progress.
audioOutput.unsupported: Select the output in your system sound settings.
audioOutput.permissionHelp: This browser cannot request output devices. Use system sound settings.
audioOutput.rollbackFailed: Output routing failed. Reopen the app to restore system output.
audioOutput.noSignal: No test signal reached the output. Retry or reopen the app.

audioExport.renderCancelNote: Cancel prevents saving. Audio rendering already in progress may continue using CPU until it finishes.

sfx.subtitle: Advanced Sound Effect Synthesizer
sfx.shortcuts: Shortcuts: A/B (slots) · 1-8,Q,W,E,R,T,Y,U (presets) · Space (play) · L (loop) · M (mutate) · Ctrl+Z (undo)

waveform.title: Waveform Display
waveform.description: Time-domain shape of the audio signal. Y-axis is amplitude (-1 to 1), X-axis is time.

spectrum.title: Frequency Spectrum
spectrum.description: Shows which frequencies are present. Taller bars = more prominent frequency. Logarithmic scale.

amplitude.title: Signal Level
amplitude.description: RMS (average loudness) and Peak level in dB. Red peak = clipping.

envelope.title: Volume Envelope
envelope.description: Overall volume shape from start to finish, shaped by Attack, Sustain, and Decay.

p_freq_ramp.title: Frequency Slide
p_freq_ramp.description: Pitch slides up (+) or down (-) over time.

p_env_attack.title: Attack
p_env_attack.description: How quickly the sound fades in.

p_env_sustain.title: Sustain
p_env_sustain.description: How long the sound holds at full volume.

p_env_punch.title: Punch
p_env_punch.description: Extra burst of volume at the start of sustain.

p_env_decay.title: Decay
p_env_decay.description: How quickly the sound fades out.

p_arp_mod.title: Arpeggio Mod
p_arp_mod.description: Pitch jump amount for arpeggio effect.

p_lpf_freq.title: Low-pass Filter
p_lpf_freq.description: Cuts high frequencies. Lower = darker sound.

p_hpf_freq.title: High-pass Filter
p_hpf_freq.description: Cuts low frequencies. Higher = thinner sound.

voice.loadFile: Drop audio file here or click to browse
voice.dropAudio: Drop audio file or click to upload
voice.subtitle: Voice Synthesis & Real-time Processing

timeline.name: Name
timeline.mixerHelp: Solo temporarily overrides saved mute states; Clear solos restores them. Solo also affects export. The green dot marks an audible track. Listen only changes the saved mix.
timeline.startHelp: Import a recording, or select several aligned microphone files to create separate tracks. You can also open a saved project.

common.dropAudio: Drop audio file here or click to browse

tts.title: Text to Speech
tts.systemVoiceHint: Rendered on this device with the system voices; nothing is uploaded. Download higher-quality voices in Settings › Accessibility › Spoken Content › Voices.

about.title: About
about.description: Cross-platform audio workstation combining sound synthesis, voice effects processing, and a timeline waveform editor. Built with Tauri 2 + React + TypeScript + Rust.

licenses.title: Third-Party Licenses
licenses.intro: CrispAudio is built with the following open-source packages.

interview.invalidSession: Not a supported CrispAudio sync session
interview.replace: Import as a new project? Save your current project first if needed. You can undo this import in this session.
interview.previewFailed: Video preview could not be loaded. Check that the original video still exists and its codec is supported.
interview.reviewHelp: Offset is the recorder time corresponding to video time zero. Positive values trim the beginning of the recording. Weak matches require manual review and confirmation. Select an output folder to keep the aligned tracks. Only the first microphone will play initially; use solo/mute to compare.
interview.confirmOffset: I reviewed and confirmed this offset
interview.import: Align and import as new project
interview.matchLevels: Match listening levels with constant gain (no denoising or compression)
interview.title: Media tools
interview.steps: 1 Choose files → 2 Check sync → 3 Edit & export
interview.editHelp: Choose a microphone, edit the audio, then export with the original picture.
interview.listenHelp: Compare microphones. These buttons change the active mix for the whole timeline.
interview.setupHelp: Choose a video with camera audio. External recordings are optional; with recordings, review synchronization before import. Import creates a new project.
interview.mobileHelp: Automatic video sync and MP4 export currently require the desktop app with FFmpeg. On iPhone/iPad, import aligned WAVs from Files, edit their audio on the timeline, and export the mix. Desktop linked projects contain Mac file paths and cannot be transferred directly.

alignment.title: Check alignment
alignment.help: Overlay two microphones on the same time scale. Look for matching speech starts and transients; check several positions for drift.
alignment.chart: Normalized audio envelopes on a shared timeline
alignment.note: Each envelope is normalized within this window, before gain, fades and effects. Different microphones can have different shapes; this view alone does not prove synchronization. No offsets are changed.

video.noPicture: No video clip here · black output
video.seek: Seek video on the shared timeline
video.rangeHelp: The range trims edited picture and mixed audio together at export. Edited picture is re-encoded. Only a completely untouched full-length source keeps its original compressed picture. Audio clip positions are independent of picture edits.
video.invalidRange: Enter a valid range: 0 ≤ in < out ≤ recording duration.

editor.panHelp: Trackpad sideways · Shift+wheel · Ctrl/Cmd+wheel to zoom
editor.newHelp: Save the current arrangement first if you want to keep it. Clear starts an empty audio timeline. You can also undo this reset.
editor.trackFilesHelp: Save selected tracks, clips, effects and embedded audio as a reusable project. Load tracks adds these lanes at their saved positions without replacing the current project.
editor.muteOverridden: Saved mute is temporarily overridden by Solo

sync.title: Auto-sync tracks
sync.desktop: Track synchronization requires the desktop app.
sync.help: Choose a reference and at least one other track containing the same recording. Analysis uses the current clip positions before mix gain/effects. Review the result before applying.
sync.offsetOnly: Apply offsets moves clips only; it does not correct clock drift. Positive offsets move the target earlier. Audio before time zero is trimmed. For long recordings with drift, use Add video + recordings to render corrected source files.
sync.changed: The arrangement changed during analysis. Analyze it again.

editing.precisionHelp: Arrow keys: 1 ms; Shift: 100 ms; Alt: 1 sample. Alt-drag bypasses snapping. Exact positions can be entered above.
editing.returnVoice: Apply to original clip and return
editing.voiceTarget: Editing a timeline clip. Send back to replace its source; Undo in Timeline restores it.
editing.invalidVideo: Invalid timing: keep source bounds, fades within the clip, and overlaps equal to the incoming transition.
editing.videoHelp: Picture edits use the project frame rate. Linked timing edits also affect audio. Existing linked overlaps can change transition style; unlink before changing camera or overlap length. Enter commits numeric edits; Escape cancels.
editing.needPrevious: A transition needs a preceding clip. Use Fade in on the first clip.
editing.transitionTiming: Changing the style of an existing overlap preserves its timing. Creating an overlap or changing its length moves an unlinked picture clip; audio stays in place. Unlink before removing a linked overlap. Gaps show black.
editing.advancedTransitions: Match cut: align matching frames and use Cut. Page peel uses a shaded, mirrored fold; it is not a 3D page simulation.
editing.approximatePreview: Approximate effect preview; export uses FFmpeg
editing.overviewHelp: Drag to browse the timeline; drag the red cursor to seek

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.mediaHelp: Add sources here and insert them at the playhead. New cameras append to the arrangement. Camera audio can stay linked to picture.
workspace.insertTrack: Insert audio on a new track
workspace.overlap: Move the playhead to a gap before inserting picture.
workspace.linkHelp: Linked picture and audio move, trim, split and delete together. Unlink for independent edits. Shift-select clips to create a link.
workspace.selectClip: Select a clip to inspect it.
workspace.rippleHelp: Removes this time interval from every track, shifts later clips, markers and captions. Undo restores it. Remove picture transitions first.
workspace.micHelp: Compare two aligned microphones. Suggestions use relative signal levels, not speaker recognition. Review each section. Applying replaces their gain automation and mutes other tracks.
workspace.pointHelp: Add a point at the playhead. The yellow line shows gain automation; preview and export interpolate between points.
workspace.textHelp: Import timed SRT, VTT or JSON segments from CrisperWeaver. Click a passage to seek and select its interval. Edit captions or remove a passage across all tracks.
workspace.loudnessHelp: Targets −16 LUFS with a −1 dB peak ceiling using measured EBU R128 loudness. This changes track gain; effects and automation are excluded from the measurement.
workspace.relinkHelp: The project references a missing file. Locate its replacement to continue loading.
workspace.driftHelp: Drift correction creates new audio sources; originals remain available for Undo. Linked picture supports offsets only.
workspace.denoiseHelp: Conservative FFT noise reduction and rumble filtering. Creates a new source; Undo restores the original. Review for speech artifacts.
workspace.oneSource: Select a track using one audio source.
workspace.linkedOnly: Save or reimport this source as a linked audio file first.
workspace.durationChanged: Cleanup changed the source duration; original audio retained.

usability.contextHelp: Help mode: hover, focus or tap a highlighted control.
usability.help_snap: Clips snap to nearby edges while dragging. Alt temporarily disables snapping; this button toggles it.
usability.help_waveform: Highlighted: each waveform is normalized for readability. Off: compare relative levels. This never changes gain, playback or export.
usability.help_split: Cuts at the red playhead. Scissors splits selected clips; Layers splits all clips crossing that position. Linked picture and sound stay together. Undo restores the cut.
usability.help_inspector: Select a clip, then open its settings to edit timing, fades and picture transitions. Linked timing edits affect its audio/video partner too.
usability.help_mixer: Adjust each track’s Mute, Solo, volume and fades. These settings affect playback and export. Compact rows keep these controls available here.
usability.help_nudge: Left/right moves the selected clips by the chosen step. Linked clips move together. With no selection, the buttons seek instead.
usability.help_play: Play/Pause controls playback. Stop returns to the beginning. The skip buttons jump to the start or end. POS lets you enter an exact position.
usability.help_loop: Repeats the whole arrangement. Highlighted means loop is enabled.
usability.help_mute: Silences this track. Solo temporarily overrides saved mute states; clearing solos restores them. Mute affects export too.
usability.help_solo: Hear soloed tracks while other tracks stay silent. Solo overrides mute temporarily. Clear solos to restore the saved mix. Solo affects export too.
usability.help_sync: Choose a camera recording and external microphone files, analyze their offsets, then review and import the aligned tracks. Desktop media tools require FFmpeg.
usability.help_files: New clears the arrangement after confirmation. Open loads a saved project; Save keeps tracks, clips and timing. Keep linked media files available beside your project.
usability.fullscreenFallback: Native fullscreen is unavailable; the viewer fills this window.
usability.importDestinationHelp: Choose a destination. New tracks start together at the playhead; files imported into one track are placed consecutively.
usability.newTrackEach: A new track for each file
usability.importProjectChanged: The project changed during import. Import again into the new arrangement.
usability.importTrackMissing: The destination track was removed during import.
usability.help_move: On touch, selection mode lets you select clips and swipe to browse. Enable the hand button to move clips or drag their edges to trim. With a mouse, drag directly. Alt temporarily disables snapping.
usability.help_navigation: Video, audio and ruler share one time scale. Shift+wheel or sideways trackpad motion scrolls; Ctrl/Cmd+wheel zooms. Fit all resets the view. Drag the blue overview window to browse or its red cursor to seek.
usability.help_reorder: Drag the six-dot handle onto another audio track header. Use its arrow keys or the up/down buttons for precise ordering. Reordering changes display order, not timing or sound. Hold near the top or bottom edge to scroll to other tracks; Escape cancels a drag. You can drop over a waveform as well as a header.
usability.help_overlap: Audio clips mix when they overlap. Shift-select two partially overlapping clips and use Crossfade selected audio overlap to add S-curve fades. Drag two video clips into a partial overlap to create a cross dissolve; Clip settings changes its transition. Three simultaneous video clips or complete containment are not supported on this composition lane.
usability.help_time: Click POS or DUR and enter seconds or mm:ss.mmm; Enter commits, Escape cancels. Duration adds empty space after your clips and cannot trim existing content. Audio export includes this silent tail.
usability.help_import: Choose an existing destination track or a new track for each file. Reading, decoding and waveform preparation are shown separately and can be cancelled. Desktop file links are retained for efficient saves. Large compressed recordings still need decoding.
usability.help_height: The height control affects both video and audio, from 24 to 640 pixels. Compact audio rows hide mixer controls; open the mixer to change Mute, Solo or gain. A small status dot still shows whether a compact track is audible.
usability.help_remove: Trash in a track header removes that lane. Removing video keeps its audio and unlinks it. The toolbar trash removes selected clips, including linked audio/video partners. Undo restores either action.
usability.help_fullscreen: Expand video opens a viewport-filling viewer and requests native fullscreen where available. Playback and frame-step controls stay visible. Escape or the shrink button closes it. In the expanded viewer, Left/Right steps frames and Space toggles playback. Tab stays among viewer controls; timeline editing shortcuts are isolated.
usability.help_fades: Audio uses the chosen curve; video fades linearly to/from black. Durations are limited to each clip length.
usability.help_range: Drag the ruler to select a time range. Drag its edges or enter exact start/end times. Play range uses this range; Loop repeats it. Clip selection stays separate.
usability.help_lock: Protects this track’s clips from edits, including linked picture edits, paste and track deletion. Mute, solo, level and pan still work. Unlock before editing.
usability.help_trim: For a roll, select the clips on the left of one shared cut. Linked sound and picture follow together. Positive values move the edge later; source handles are checked before applying.
usability.help_groups: Groups join clips for selection and editing without replacing their AV source links. Splits retain membership. Pasted copies get independent groups. Disable group editing to work on individual members; AV links remain active.

analysis.spectrumHelp: Relative FFT spectrum of a representative loud window; not a calibrated level meter.

rack.orderHelp: Effects run from top to bottom. Changes stop playback; play again to audition.

fades.title: Fade selected clips
fades.videoHelp: Audio uses the chosen curve; video fades linearly to/from black. Durations are limited to each clip length.

videoColor.title: Colour correction
videoColor.applySelected: Apply colour to selected picture clips
videoColor.help: Applied before fades and transitions. Preview and export use the same settings; colour management and encoding may cause small visual differences.

videoTransform.title: Picture orientation
videoTransform.copy: Apply orientation to selected picture clips
videoTransform.help: Fits inside the existing picture frame. Audio and timing stay unchanged.

mediaFormats.title: Export video
mediaFormats.appleHelp: Uses Apple system codecs and native picture transitions, fades, colour and orientation. Whip, glitch and page peel need a supported Metal GPU. This choice never falls back.
mediaFormats.ffmpegHelp: Requires a separately installed FFmpeg with the chosen encoder. Its licence depends on that build; the Homebrew build may include GPL components. AV1 can be slow.
mediaFormats.notices: Bundled codec copyright and licence notices

ranges.rangeHelp: Drag the ruler to select a time range. Drag its edges or enter exact start/end times. Play range uses this range; Loop repeats it. Clip selection stays separate.

rangeEdits.title: Edit time range
rangeEdits.explain: Lift removes content and leaves a gap. Extract closes the gap on included tracks. Insert adds a gap of the selected length at its start.
rangeEdits.global: Apply this edit to canvas duration, global markers and transcript cues
rangeEdits.linkHelp: Linked picture and sound must both be included. Save scope remembers which tracks participate in future range edits.
rangeEdits.invalid: Choose a valid range inside the timeline.
rangeEdits.scope: Include at least one existing track.
rangeEdits.linkedScope: Include all linked picture and sound tracks, or unlink the clips first.
rangeEdits.locked: Unlock the affected tracks or explicitly exclude them from this edit.
rangeEdits.transitionBoundary: A range boundary crosses a video transition. Move the boundary outside the blend, or edit the affected transition first. Other transitions may remain.
rangeEdits.cueBoundary: A range boundary crosses a transcript cue. Move it to a cue boundary or review/edit that cue first.
rangeEdits.pictureTopology: This cut would create an unsupported picture overlap. Adjust its boundaries or the affected transition.
rangeEdits.changed: The arrangement changed. Review the current range again.
rangeEdits.groupScope: Include every named group track, or disable group editing.
rangeEdits.cutExplanation: Only crossed blends change. The cut uses the original blend end and keeps source timing; the times below include this range edit.

trimEdits.title: Trim tools
trimEdits.help: For a roll, select the clips on the left of a shared cut or picture transition. Linked sound and picture follow together. The transition keeps its type and length; its overlap window moves with the edit. Positive values move later; source handles are checked.
trimEdits.rippleHelp: Ripple uses saved lane participation and retimes the canvas, markers, automation and transcript. Linked picture transitions keep their type and overlap length. Review scope in Edit time range first; extending source speech requires fresh ASR alignment.
trimEdits.amount: Enter a valid nonzero trim amount.
trimEdits.sharedCut: Selected linked clips must share the edited edge.
trimEdits.adjacent: Each selected left clip needs exactly one adjacent right clip.
trimEdits.linkedCut: The adjacent clips must include the complete right-hand link group.
trimEdits.blend: Sliding through a picture blend is not supported yet. Choose abutting cuts.
trimEdits.handles: This trim exceeds available source handles or leaves a clip too short.
trimEdits.locked: Unlock the affected left and right tracks before trimming.
trimEdits.scope: Selected lanes must participate in ripple edits. Review their saved scope first.
trimEdits.frameEdge: Picture trims need frame-aligned edit edges.
trimEdits.slideHelp: Select a middle clip between two neighbouring cuts or transitions. Its source content and duration stay fixed; neighbours are trimmed to fill the move. Existing transition types and overlap lengths stay fixed. Linked audio/video follows. Timeline length, markers and automation stay fixed; re-align any ASR transcript afterward.
trimEdits.slideSpan: Selected linked clips must share their edit boundaries, accounting for incoming picture overlaps.
trimEdits.slideAdjacent: Each selected lane needs one middle clip and two unambiguous neighbouring cuts or transitions.
trimEdits.slideLimits: Edit boundaries: {{start}}–{{end}} s. Source handles allow {{min}} to +{{max}} s.
trimEdits.blendTopology: The edit needs valid, frame-aligned picture overlaps matching their transitions. Fix ambiguous overlaps first.

editGroups.title: Named edit groups
editGroups.help: Groups join clips for selection and editing without replacing their AV source links. Splits retain membership. Pasted copies get independent groups. Disable group editing to work on individual members; AV links remain active.
editGroups.name: Group name
editGroups.invalid: Select clips and enter a group name (1–120 characters).
editGroups.failed: This group change could not be applied.
editGroups.locked: Unlock the affected lanes before changing their clip groups.

spoken.title: Speech editor
spoken.help: Select a timed word, then Delete to cut its sound and picture across every track. Undo restores the complete edit. Caption corrections below only change text and clear word alignment.
spoken.setupHelp: Choose local CrispASR and models. Auto downloads the aligner on first use. Transcription uses 15-second chunks with forced word alignment. Video cuts cover the word with whole frames.
spoken.working: Rendering audio, transcribing and aligning words…
spoken.desktop: ASR needs desktop and linked 48 kHz audio. Saved timed words can also be edited in the browser.
spoken.editor: Spoken words (Delete cuts audio and video)
spoken.untimed: This word has no valid alignment. Transcribe or align first.
spoken.tooShort: This word is shorter than one video frame.
spoken.neighbour: The frame-aligned cut overlaps another word. Review word timing before deleting.
spoken.stale: Audio arrangement changed. Transcribe or align again before word cuts.

keepSpeech.title: Keep pasted text
keepSpeech.help: Paste a shortened transcript, or load the original and delete words here. Compare, review the matching passages, then keep only their audio and video. Order stays unchanged; punctuation and case may differ.
keepSpeech.placeholder: Paste the passages you want to keep…
keepSpeech.summary: Keep {{kept}} words; remove {{deleted}}. {{passages}} passages, {{duration}} s total.
keepSpeech.changed: Project changed. Compare again before applying.
keepSpeech.ambiguous: “{{word}}” has several matching occurrences. Choose a passage or explicitly use the earliest/latest complete match.
keepSpeech.many: More than 200 occurrences. Add context, or choose earliest/latest.
keepSpeech.untimed: A complete word-timed transcript is required. Transcribe/align first.
keepSpeech.empty: Keep at least one matching word.
keepSpeech.mismatch: The pasted words do not occur in that order. Use deletion-only edits of this transcript; new wording and reordered passages cannot be matched automatically.
keepSpeech.partialWord: This edit removes part of one aligned word (for example a hyphenated word). Keep or delete the complete timed word.
keepSpeech.neighbour: A retained video frame contains speech marked for removal. Review the boundary word timing first.
keepSpeech.tooLarge: This text exceeds the current 100,000-token / 1 MB comparison limit.
keepSpeech.tooManyCuts: This edit exceeds the current 2,000-cut limit. Edit a shorter section.

trimFeedback.title: Source handles
trimFeedback.limit: Source or timeline limit reached. The edge stays within available media.
trimFeedback.missingSource: Source unavailable; load the recording before trimming.
trimFeedback.invalidSource: Invalid source bounds; this trim was not applied.

mixer.title: Mixer
mixer.meterHelp: Peak (green), RMS (blue), held peak. Click to reset.

eq.title: Equalizer
eq.help: Drag points: frequency/gain. Arrow keys: fine; Shift: coarse. Curve shows enabled EQ bands only.

dynamics.reductionHelp: Live DSP readout. With several compressors: greatest individual reduction, not their sum.
dynamics.limiterHelp: After master level/effects. Stereo-linked, instant attack, adjustable release. No true-peak or LUFS measurement.

automation.title: Gain automation
automation.help: Click to add · drag to move · Delete to remove · arrows: sample / 0.1 dB, Shift ×10 · Alt bypasses snap · Escape cancels · −60 dB = silence
automation.pasteHelp: Replaces this interval only. Outside gain is retained, with boundary transitions over one project sample. Source audio and clip timing stay fixed.
automation.bounds: Choose a valid range within the project canvas (at least one sample).
automation.lockedEnvelope: Unlock the destination track before pasting automation.
automation.changed: The project changed. Close and reopen Paste to review the current envelope.
automation.panHelp: Pan points override the static pan. Linear between points; endpoints hold. Delete all points to use static pan. Drag or use arrows; Shift increases the step. Alt bypasses snapping.
automation.curveHelp: Curve to the next point: Linear ramps; Step holds, then jumps at the next point.
automation.mixCopy: Copy delay mix envelope / selected range
automation.feedbackCopy: Copy delay feedback envelope / selected range
automation.fxPasteHelp: Only this delay parameter changes. Surrounding points are preserved with one-sample boundary guards. Other insert settings and media timing stay fixed.
automation.panPasteHelp: Only pan points change. Surrounding pan is preserved with one-sample boundary guards. Static pan and gain stay unchanged.
automation.parameterMismatch: The copied envelope belongs to a different parameter.
automation.mixHelp: Delay wet/dry mix: linear 0–100%, held endpoints. Empty lane uses static mix. Commit on release; Escape cancels. The envelope stays with its insert when reordered.
automation.timeHelp: Delay time in milliseconds (0–2000). Linear changes move the delay read head and can change pitch; Step jumps at the next point. An empty lane uses the insert’s static time.
automation.ringmodShapeHelp: Adds {{count}} editable linear mix points between these endpoints. Outside automation stays fixed. Apply is one undo step.
automation.reverbShapeHelp: Adds {{count}} editable linear mix points between these endpoints. Outside automation stays fixed. Apply is one undo step.
automation.reverbMixHelp: Automate reverb mix from 0% dry to maximum reverb with 30% dry retained. Empty envelopes use the insert mix; live edits retain the convolution tail.
automation.reverbMixCopy: Copy reverb mix envelope / selected range
automation.reverbPasteHelp: Replaces only this reverb mix interval with outside one-sample guards. Stretch changes times, retaining values and curves. Effect types have separate clipboards.
automation.chorusShapeHelp: Adds {{count}} editable linear mix points between these endpoints. Outside automation stays fixed. Apply is one undo step.
automation.chorusDepthHelp: Automate chorus depth from 0–100% (up to ±10 ms). Empty envelopes use insert depth, default 50%. Edits retain delay history and LFO phase.
automation.chorusDepthCopy: Copy chorus depth envelope / selected range
automation.chorusDepthPasteHelp: Time stretch changes point clocks, retaining depth values. Other parameters stay fixed; outside points and locks are protected.
automation.chorusDepthShapeHelp: Apply creates {{count}} interior points. Endpoints and outside depth stay fixed; delay history and LFO phase continue.
automation.chorusMixHelp: Automate chorus mix from 0% dry to 100% delayed voices. Empty envelopes use the insert mix; live edits retain delay history and modulation phase.
automation.chorusMixCopy: Copy chorus mix envelope / selected range
automation.chorusPasteHelp: Replaces only this chorus mix interval with outside one-sample guards. Stretch changes times, retaining values and curves. Effect types have separate clipboards.
automation.distortionShapeHelp: Adds {{count}} editable linear mix points between these endpoints. Outside automation stays fixed. Apply is one undo step.
automation.distortionMixHelp: Automate distortion mix from 0% dry to 100% saturated. Empty envelopes use the insert mix; live edits keep the oversampling filters running.
automation.distortionMixCopy: Copy distortion mix envelope / selected range
automation.distortionPasteHelp: Replaces only this distortion mix interval with outside one-sample guards. Stretch changes times, retaining values and curves. Effect types have separate clipboards.
automation.bitcrushShapeHelp: Adds {{count}} editable linear mix points between these endpoints. Outside automation stays fixed. Apply is one undo step.
automation.bitcrushMixHelp: Automate bit-crusher mix from 0% dry to 100% quantized. Empty envelopes use the insert mix; live edits keep the effect graph running.
automation.bitcrushMixCopy: Copy bit crushing mix envelope / selected range
automation.bitcrushPasteHelp: Replaces only this bit-crusher mix interval with outside one-sample guards. Stretch changes times, retaining values and curves. Effect types have separate clipboards.
automation.ringmodMixHelp: Automate ring modulation mix from 0% dry to 100% modulated. Empty envelopes use the insert mix; edits keep the carrier running.
automation.ringmodMixCopy: Copy ring modulation mix envelope / selected range
automation.ringmodPasteHelp: Replaces only this ring modulation mix interval with one-sample outside guards. Stretch changes clocks, keeping values and curves. Delay and ring modulation use separate clipboards.
automation.shapeHelp: Adds {{count}} editable linear points between these endpoints. Shapes interpolate gain amplitude, pan or the selected delay value. Outside automation stays fixed. Apply is one undo step.
automation.shapeBounds: Select a point with a following point at least two samples later, inside the timeline.
automation.flatShapeHelp: Equal endpoint values keep this segment flat. Apply leaves the project and redo unchanged.
automation.invalidShapeControls: Handle values must be between 0 and 100%; time handles cannot cross.
automation.inlineShapeHelp: Select a start or interior shape point. Drag or use arrows to reshape the whole span. Release commits once; Escape cancels. Shift uses larger steps.
automation.customShapeHelp: Drag handles or use arrows (Shift: larger steps). Time handles cannot cross; values stay between the endpoints. Apply keeps the displayed linear points.
automation.feedbackHelp: Delay feedback: linear 0–95%, held endpoints. Empty lane uses static feedback. Live edits keep echo history. Commit on release; Escape cancels.
automation.passReviewHelp: Only these intervals change, with one-sample outside guards. Apply is one undo step; Cancel keeps the original envelope and redo history.
automation.recordLimit: Automation pass limit reached. Draft discarded.
automation.recordDiscontinuity: Seeking, looping or restarting cancels the automation draft.
automation.recordInterrupted: Automation draft cancelled after an interruption.
automation.recordHelp_read: Read follows the envelope. Choose a mode and explicitly arm while stopped to record a pass. Changing lanes cancels drafts.
automation.recordHelp_touch: Touch records while holding the control; release returns to the original envelope. Stop playback to review. Escape cancels.
automation.recordHelp_latch: Latch records from the first touch until Stop, holding the last touched value. Review before Apply; Escape cancels.
automation.recordHelp_write: Write records continuously from playback start until Stop. Explicit arm and review protect existing envelopes; Escape cancels.
automation.chorusRateHelp: Automate chorus LFO rate from 0 to 8 Hz. Zero holds phase; empty envelopes use insert rate, default 1.5 Hz. Live edits keep phase and delay history.
automation.chorusRateCopy: Copy chorus rate envelope / selected range
automation.chorusRatePasteHelp: Replaces only this chorus rate interval with outside guards. Stretch changes times, keeping Hz values and curves. Later modulation phase follows the edited frequency history.
automation.chorusRateShapeHelp: Preview the chorus rate transition in Hz. Apply replaces this span with {{count}} editable points; mix and depth stay independent.

routing.title: Routing and sends
routing.cycle: This route creates feedback. Choose another bus.
routing.busClips: Audio clips belong on audio tracks, not buses.

loudness.title: Master loudness
loudness.limited: The peak ceiling limits loudness. The measured result is below the target.
loudness.help: Meter follows the master output. Review measures the full mix at 48 kHz and verifies the gain adjustment. Original recordings stay intact.
loudness.silence: No measurable programme loudness. Use at least 400 ms of audible audio.
loudness.invalid: Invalid loudness target or peak ceiling.
loudness.changed: The project changed. Measure the mix again.
loudness.peakFailed: Could not verify the requested true-peak ceiling.

picture.name: Track name
picture.stackHelp: The top track overlays lower tracks. Hidden tracks are excluded from preview/export. Audio stays independently mixed.
picture.keyframeHelp: Each point sets the outgoing curve. Left trims and splits retain the original animation clock.
picture.silentPlacement: Places picture without camera audio. Insert shifts the arrangement; overwrite replaces this picture track and keeps its independently mixed sound.

recording.title: Record / takes
recording.help: One input track at a time. Connect requests microphone access. Monitoring is off until explicitly enabled; captured originals remain available through undo and take selection.
recording.locked: Unlock an audio track before recording or comping.
recording.rightUnavailable: This input has no second channel; choose mono/channel 1.
recording.rangeRequired: Set an edit range for punch or loop recording.
recording.projectChanged: Project changed during capture; the original was preserved.
recording.captureStopped: Capture could not flush its final block; completed blocks were retained.
recording.budget: Recording reached the memory budget and stopped.
recording.empty: No recorded audio falls inside the selected range.
recording.invalidComp: Comp range exceeds the original take.
recording.calibrationMissing: No clear calibration signal. Use a loopback connection or set compensation manually.
recording.calibrationHelp: Plays a short chirp and measures the selected input. Connect output to input for calibration; review the result before applying.
recording.selectRegion: Drag to select a comp range
recording.unlink: Unlink camera sound before replacing it with a recorded comp.
recording.overlap: Choose a separate recording track or resolve overlapping base clips before comping.

retime.title: Speed / pitch
retime.help: Retimes the selected clip and its linked picture/sound. Originals remain available. Timing changes keep the clip start; overlaps with neighbouring picture must be resolved first.
retime.quality: Voice-oriented WSOLA stretch. Large changes can create audible artifacts. Video duplicates/drops nearest frames at the project frame rate; no optical flow. Desktop derived media is retained through undo and reopen.
retime.bounds: Original source is missing or the interval exceeds its bounds.
retime.desktop: Derived retiming requires the desktop app.
retime.overlap: Retiming creates an invalid picture overlap. Move neighbouring clips first.
retime.stale: The project changed while preparing retiming. Review again.
retime.detachMulticam: Keep cuts and detach the multicam scene before retiming.

multicam.title: Multicam
multicam.help: Use camera clips already aligned on separate picture layers. The shared coverage becomes a multicam scene; outside coverage stays in place. Shot switches keep microphone tracks and routing unchanged.
multicam.name: Scene name
multicam.confirmSync: I reviewed the aligned camera placement
multicam.savedSync: {{count}} saved synchronization decisions; current placement is the group clock.
multicam.switchHelp: Click an angle or press 1–9 while this panel is open. Each switch cuts the active shot at the playhead and preserves following cuts.
multicam.select: Choose 2–9 camera clips and a scene name.
multicam.locked: Unlock the camera clips. Detach retimed or existing multicam clips before grouping.
multicam.coverage: These angles have no shared coverage at the playhead.
multicam.overlap: The scene would create an invalid picture overlap.

sourceSpeech.title: Source transcript
sourceSpeech.help: Original timestamps belong to a source recording. Timeline words are mapped from each clip, including trims, repeats and retiming. Select speech, review the affected ranges, then lift or extract.
sourceSpeech.contract: Uses the CrispASR executable/model/aligner configured in Spoken editing. The backend receives the full original source at offset zero; no timestamp guessing from subtitles.
sourceSpeech.correct: Correct source words and speaker labels
sourceSpeech.speaker: Speaker label
sourceSpeech.scope: Applies across all picture, sound, graphics, captions, markers and sections. Locked content or partial neighbouring words block the proposal. Original source transcripts stay intact.
sourceSpeech.partial: Select complete mapped words with source timing first.
sourceSpeech.neighbour: Frame rounding would cut an unselected word. Review the selection.
sourceSpeech.bounds: Transcript timing exceeds the original source.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.stemNote: Solo stems include routed returns and master processing. Nonlinear stems may not sum to the full mix.
delivery.desktop: Delivery queue and media collection require the desktop app.
delivery.packageNote: Copies referenced media, originals and stills into a new folder. Embedded audio stays in the project. Nothing is moved or overwritten.
delivery.cutNote: Cut-only OTIO export: review omissions before saving. This is not a complete project round trip.
delivery.invalid: Check duration, dimensions, frame rate and encoding settings.
delivery.unsupported: Mono is supported for WAV; ProRes needs MOV; stems are audio-only and caption burn-in needs video.
delivery.stemsMissing: Choose at least one track or bus.
delivery.linkedRequired: FLAC/AAC delivery requires a linked 48 kHz project on macOS. WAV also supports in-memory audio.
